notes: Kai's head in three dimensions: the sculptor's targets for likeness/dense_fit.py (stage B), transcribed from the shape study's SHAPE_SPEC.md section 4 (the 12 biggest shape differences between the round-3 build and the owner's photo, each with a measurable target and a confidence). Derived numbers only, no pixels. Frame: face mm (photo mm = build mm x likenessScale), origin = the midpoint of the inner eye corners (MediaPipe 133 / 362 traced onto the base mesh, mp_to_mh.json 'front'), x his left, y up, z forward. Kinds: top (the vertex's height), z (front-most surface depth at (x, y)), zrel (z(x, y) - z(x2, y2)), zsec (second difference z(x) - 2 z(x + h) + z(x + 2h) on the section y: a groove > 0, a corner < 0), zdrop (z(x, y) - z(x2, y)), width (the section y's width, front of zmin), lm / lmrel (a MediaPipe landmark's coordinate), brow_eye (z(x, y) minus the upper lid's lash line, the eye's front as seen), ybot (the lowest surface point at (x, z)), length (glabella to the back of the vault). band: [lo, hi] (null = open); conf: high 1.0, medium 0.5, low 0.2 (the residual's weight, mm outside the band). spec: the SHAPE_SPEC item.
